basic_info.description: Experience luxury living at the Millennium Tower! Recently completed retrofit, Millenium Tower is a 5 Star residential building with world-class amenities that include 24 hour concierge service along with 20,000 sq ft club level equipped with Owner's Lounge with food service from International Smoke, fitness center, private screening room, saline lap pool, spa/hot tub, outdoor terrace and more! This bright and spacious one bedroom and one bathroom unit offers an open floor plan, gourmet kitchen that features sub-zero and Bosch appliances. Directly adjacent to Salesforce Park and the new SF Transbay Terminal. A short walk to the Ferry Building, shopping, restaurants and the financial district. Easy access to the Bay Bridge, highways 80/101/280.
